comments.body:
@bobylito Had a good idea about putting a link somewhere like "Something is missing" "I can't find what I want" "Give feedback" 

that would work just as the Algolia docs. Maybe we could just link it to "new issue" on GitHub directly. Well that requires a GitHub account but still.
Or to a google form, that's an easy win. Now where would such link be?

Deploy preview ready!

Built with commit 1ed34f6134a0a3add1e306e1b2add1469e031e8e

https://deploy-preview-2438--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com

> @bobylito Had a good idea about putting a link somewhere like "Something is missing" "I can't find what I want" "Give feedback"

Love it. That's a great idea!

> Now where would such link be?

A banner? Or we could have a question mark menu in the bar and have a link in it?

> A banner?

I would use banner only for good news, they take too much space for such a "I have a problem" matter (kind of feels like everyone has issues with the doc, which is not the case).

I would put it at the bottom of every webpages. Most probably people will read deeply any webpage to understand that they are missing some information.

So I propose to add "Missing some documentation? [Let us know](LINK TO NEW ISSUE)!" at the end of every page.

> So I propose to add "Missing some documentation? [Let us know](LINK TO NEW ISSUE)!" at the end of every page.

Sounds good to me! :)
